fusions.name: Dabbling Rake
fusions.desc: Skims the tines across the ground ahead, dealing 4 water damage to everything within 2 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Gig the Soaked
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target, such as [Soaked], and uses it up: a gigging thrust at up to 5 tiles for 8 piercing damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Turned Aside
fusions.desc: For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Rolls Off the Back
fusions.desc: Once every 120 seconds, a blow that would kill you is refused, leaving you at 1 health.
